title: HACK: Homomorphic Acceleration via Compression of the Key-Value Cache for Disaggregated LLM Inference (artifact)
description: Artifact of the ATC '26 paper "HACK: Homomorphic Acceleration via Compression of the Key-Value Cache for Disaggregated LLM Inference": the implementation of HACK (quantized KV cache, attention on 2-bit codes, Triton kernels, vLLM and Hugging Face integrations), the two comparison methods, the experiment scripts, tests and a Dockerfile. The README maps the components to the sections of the paper and gives the commands and expected results of every experiment.
